title: Lapita voyagers reach Remote Oceania
place: Bismarck Archipelago to Vanuatu, Fiji, Tonga and Samoa
summary: Lapita potters sailed east from the Bismarck Archipelago, arriving in Vanuatu, Fiji, Tonga and Samoa about 1000-900 BCE. DNA from four skeletons (2016) links them to Taiwan and the Philippines.
why: Among the first to cross open ocean into Remote Oceania; the Marianas were reached earlier, by 1500 BCE.

notes.problem: Contradicted: Austronesians settled the Mariana Islands by 1500 BCE, 'becoming the first humans to reach Remote Oceania', before Lapita.
